note — the bold part is what the card te: dürfen asks for permission. ich darf: no -e, and ü becomes a in the singular.
nicht dürfen is mustn't: you are not allowed to.

English: The child **is allowed to** eat ice cream today.
note — the bold part is what the card te: es darf, the same as ich darf: no -t.
wir dürfen: the plural keeps the ü. sein is the infinitive at the end.
ihr dürft: ü plus -t.
kein Bier inside the bracket; trinken at the end.
Dürfen wir…? asks politely for permission.

English: I **am supposed to** take a tablet.
note — the bold part is what the card te: sollen: someone else, here the doctor, wants it. ich soll, no -e.

English: You **are supposed to** do your homework. (one friend)
note — the bold part is what the card te: du sollst. Hausaufgaben machen: to do homework, usually in the plural.
er soll, the same as ich soll.
Sollen wir…? offers to do something: shall we…?
Soll ich…? offers: shall I…?
ihr sollt: soll- plus -t.
sollen for a rule or advice that comes from outside.
Sollen wir…? suggests: shall we…?
mögen + a noun: to like. ich mag: no -e, ö becomes a.
du magst.
sie mag, no -t. kein Bier: not any beer.
mögen also works for people: wir mögen.
ihr mögt: ö plus -t.
er mag + keine Katzen, the plural object.
mögen + a person: ich mag ihn.

English: I **don't like** vegetables, but I have to eat them.
German: Ich **mag** kein Gemüse, aber ich muss es essen.
note — the bold part is what the card te: das Gemüse → es: one das-word in German, though English says them.

English: **Don't** you **like** wine? (one friend) – Yes, I do!
note — the bold part is what the card te: A negative question gets doch for yes.
möchte is the polite form of mögen: I would like. It is how you order.
du möchtest. noch: some more.
sie möchte, with no -t: the same as ich. The infinitive goes at the end.
wir möchten. Ordering, Bier counts in portions: zwei Bier.
ihr möchtet: möcht- plus -et.
Sie möchten: polite and formal.

English: I **would like to** take a break.
note — the bold part is what the card te: möchte + infinitive at the end: eine Pause machen.

English: He **would like** an ice cream, but he's not allowed.
German: Er **möchte** ein Eis, aber er darf nicht.
note — the bold part is what the card te: möchte says what he wants; darf nicht says it is not allowed. The infinitive can drop when it is clear.
Was möchten Sie…? is the waiter's question.
